description: Curated contradiction-detection fixtures (docs/12 M11 DoD). Each case is a two-source evidence set with a known ground truth: 'contradiction' means the sources assert claims that cannot both be true; 'consistent' is the control set — compatible or merely different facts that must NOT be flagged. Recall >= 0.80 on the contradiction set with false-positive rate <= 0.10 on the control set is the milestone bar, measured by evals/contradiction_eval.py against a real model.
